spec: FR-15 / §14 — the STOP-word lists seeded per language. The Amharic word is the ONE Ethiopic string in a source document (CONFLICTS.md); StopWordByteExactTest reads it FROM docs/Doc14-SMS-Notification-Module.md at test time and asserts byte equality against this file, the settings registry default (step 2b), the DB row (step 8) and the parsed inbound (step 8). No normalization, transliteration or trimming may alter it.
